authoring: AI 撰寫的學習內容；詞形參考 ECDICT。非官方試題。

entries.en: to accept responsibility for a task

examples.en: Our team will undertake the inspection.
examples.zh: 我們團隊將承接這項檢查工作。

entries.en: to get rid of something no longer needed

examples.en: Discard damaged packaging before shipment.
examples.zh: 出貨前請丟棄受損包材。

entries.en: to make certain that something happens

examples.en: Check the label to ensure accurate delivery.
examples.zh: 請核對標籤以確保配送正確。

entries.en: to confirm receipt or recognize something

examples.en: Please acknowledge receipt of this message.
examples.zh: 請確認收到這則訊息。

entries.en: to begin using a method or policy

examples.en: We adopted a more flexible schedule.
examples.zh: 我們採用了更有彈性的時程。

entries.en: to ask for advice or refer to information

examples.en: Consult your supervisor before making changes.
examples.zh: 變更前請先諮詢主管。

entries.en: to make something possible

examples.en: The update enables faster file sharing.
examples.zh: 這次更新讓檔案分享更快速。

entries.en: to give special importance to something

examples.en: The instructor emphasized the importance of safety.
examples.zh: 講師強調了安全的重要性。

entries.en: to improve the quality or value of something

examples.en: Better lighting enhances the shopping experience.
examples.zh: 更好的照明能提升購物體驗。

entries.en: to get something through effort or a request

examples.en: Obtain approval before placing the order.
examples.zh: 下單前請先取得核准。

entries.en: to organize and carry out an activity

examples.en: We conduct customer surveys twice a year.
examples.zh: 我們每年進行兩次顧客調查。

entries.en: to provide enough space or meet a need

examples.en: The hall can accommodate three hundred guests.
examples.zh: 這個大廳可容納三百位賓客。

entries.en: to give time or resources to a purpose

examples.en: We dedicate Fridays to staff training.
examples.zh: 我們將星期五安排為員工訓練日。

entries.en: to go with someone or something

examples.en: A guide will accompany the visitors.
examples.zh: 導覽人員將陪同訪客。

entries.en: to suggest something without stating it directly

examples.en: A lower price does not imply poor quality.
examples.zh: 價格較低不代表品質較差。

entries.en: to decide what needs attention first

examples.en: Please prioritize urgent customer requests.
examples.zh: 請優先處理緊急顧客請求。

entries.en: to develop gradually over time

examples.en: Customer preferences continue to evolve.
examples.zh: 顧客的偏好持續演變。

entries.en: to move to a new place

examples.en: The office will relocate in November.
examples.zh: 辦公室將在十一月搬遷。

entries.en: to examine something to discover facts

examples.en: We are investigating the missing shipment.
examples.zh: 我們正在調查貨物遺失事件。

entries.en: to work toward a goal

examples.en: She plans to pursue a career in accounting.
examples.zh: 她計畫從事會計工作。

entries.en: to give or deliver to several recipients

examples.en: Please distribute the agenda before the meeting.
examples.zh: 請在會議前分發議程。

entries.en: to take part or involve someone's attention

examples.en: The activities engage participants in discussion.
examples.zh: 這些活動讓參與者投入討論。

entries.en: to reduce a burden or replace someone on duty

examples.en: Extra staff will relieve the workload.
examples.zh: 增派人員將減輕工作負擔。

entries.en: to make a limited change

examples.en: We modified the design after testing.
examples.zh: 我們在測試後修改了設計。

entries.en: to extend something's period of use

examples.en: Renew your subscription before it expires.
examples.zh: 請在訂閱到期前續訂。

entries.en: to officially inform someone

examples.en: Notify us if your address changes.
examples.zh: 地址若有變更請通知我們。

entries.en: to create written text or music

examples.en: Please compose a short welcome message.
examples.zh: 請撰寫一段簡短的歡迎訊息。

entries.en: to officially recommend treatment or set a rule

examples.en: The doctor prescribed a short course of medicine.
examples.zh: 醫師開立了短期用藥處方。

entries.en: to interrupt normal activity

examples.en: The storm disrupted regional deliveries.
examples.zh: 暴風雨中斷了區域配送。

entries.en: to assign resources for a purpose

examples.en: We allocated more funds to training.
examples.zh: 我們分配了更多經費給訓練。

entries.en: to grow or succeed strongly

examples.en: Small businesses thrive in this district.
examples.zh: 小型企業在這個地區蓬勃發展。

entries.en: to believe without proof or take responsibility

examples.en: Do not assume that delivery is free.
examples.zh: 不要假設配送一定免費。

entries.en: to make a process simpler and more efficient

examples.en: The software streamlines expense reporting.
examples.zh: 這套軟體能精簡費用申報流程。

entries.en: to make something wider in range

examples.en: The course will broaden your knowledge.
examples.zh: 這門課程能拓展你的知識。

entries.en: to achieve less than expected

examples.en: The new branch underperformed last quarter.
examples.zh: 新分公司上一季的表現不如預期。

entries.en: to get something back or find stored information

examples.en: You can retrieve old invoices online.
examples.zh: 你可以在線上查找舊發票。

entries.en: to regularly check progress or conditions

examples.en: We monitor stock levels daily.
examples.zh: 我們每天監控庫存水準。

entries.en: to officially give or allow something

examples.en: The manager granted her request for leave.
examples.zh: 經理准許了她的請假申請。

entries.en: to examine something carefully

examples.en: Please review the contract before signing.
examples.zh: 簽署前請仔細閱讀合約。

entries.en: to produce goods in a factory

examples.en: The plant manufactures medical devices.
examples.zh: 這間工廠製造醫療器材。

entries.en: to judge an amount approximately

examples.en: We estimate the repair will take two hours.
examples.zh: 我們估計維修需要兩小時。

entries.en: to offer a price for a contract or item

examples.en: Three companies bid for the project.
examples.zh: 三家公司競標這項專案。

entries.en: to make a brief comment

examples.en: She remarked that the new layout was clearer.
examples.zh: 她評論新的版面更清楚。

entries.en: to use one thing instead of another

examples.en: You can substitute tea for coffee.
examples.zh: 你可以用茶代替咖啡。

entries.en: to deal with a problem or speak to a group

examples.en: We must address the delivery problem.
examples.zh: 我們必須處理配送問題。

entries.en: to draw attention to something important

examples.en: The report highlights several possible risks.
examples.zh: 報告指出了幾項可能的風險。

entries.en: to decrease or politely refuse

examples.en: Sales declined slightly in February.
examples.zh: 二月銷售略有下降。

entries.en: to increase or improve something

examples.en: The campaign boosted online sales.
examples.zh: 這次活動提升了線上銷售。

entries.en: to make something available to the public

examples.en: We will release the update tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我們明天將發布更新。

entries.en: to give a task or authority to another person

examples.en: The manager delegated routine tasks.
examples.zh: 經理將例行工作委派給他人。

entries.en: a person who starts and runs a business

examples.en: The event connects entrepreneurs with investors.
examples.zh: 這場活動讓創業家與投資人交流。

entries.en: a possible consequence or suggested meaning

examples.en: We discussed the financial implications.
examples.zh: 我們討論了可能的財務影響。

entries.en: a standard used for comparison

examples.en: This result sets a new industry benchmark.
examples.zh: 這項成果樹立了新的產業標竿。

entries.en: the list or total pay of employees

examples.en: Please submit your hours before payroll closes.
examples.zh: 請在薪資結算前提交工時。

entries.en: the sequence of tasks in a process

examples.en: The new software improves our workflow.
examples.zh: 新軟體改善了我們的工作流程。

entries.en: a general rise in prices

examples.en: Inflation increased our operating costs.
examples.zh: 通貨膨脹提高了我們的營運成本。

entries.en: an amount subtracted from a total

examples.en: The deduction appears on your payslip.
examples.zh: 這筆扣款列在你的薪資單上。

entries.en: a place equipped for an employee's work

examples.en: Each workstation has two monitors.
examples.zh: 每個工作站都有兩台螢幕。

entries.en: the buildings and land used by a business

examples.en: Smoking is prohibited on the premises.
examples.zh: 營業場所內禁止吸菸。

entries.en: a person leading a meeting or committee

examples.en: The chairperson called the meeting to order.
examples.zh: 主席宣布會議開始。

entries.en: a substance released into the environment

examples.en: The factory reduced carbon emissions.
examples.zh: 這間工廠減少了碳排放。

entries.en: the combination of two organizations

examples.en: The merger requires regulatory approval.
examples.zh: 這宗合併案需要主管機關核准。

entries.en: clothing suited to an occasion

examples.en: Business attire is required for the reception.
examples.zh: 參加招待會須穿著商務服裝。

entries.en: acknowledgment of achievement or ability to identify

examples.en: The award provides recognition for excellent service.
examples.zh: 這個獎項表揚優良服務。

entries.en: a business or organized project

examples.en: The program supports small enterprises.
examples.zh: 這項計畫支援小型企業。

entries.en: written communication between people

examples.en: Keep copies of all client correspondence.
examples.zh: 請保留所有客戶往來信件的副本。

entries.en: a person or firm hired for specific work

examples.en: The contractor will repair the roof.
examples.zh: 承包商將修繕屋頂。

entries.en: the act of occurring or working together

examples.en: The seminar runs in conjunction with the exhibition.
examples.zh: 研討會與展覽同時舉行。

entries.en: a basic product traded in large quantities

examples.en: Commodity prices affect manufacturing costs.
examples.zh: 原物料價格影響製造成本。

entries.en: the amount by which spending exceeds income

examples.en: The organization reported a budget deficit.
examples.zh: 這個組織公布了預算赤字。

entries.en: following rules or requirements

examples.en: The audit checks compliance with safety rules.
examples.zh: 稽核檢查是否遵守安全規定。

entries.en: the ability of devices to connect

examples.en: The upgrade improves network connectivity.
examples.zh: 這次升級改善了網路連線能力。

entries.en: a detailed design or plan

examples.en: The proposal provides a blueprint for expansion.
examples.zh: 這份提案提供了擴張藍圖。

entries.en: the ability to earn a profit

examples.en: Lower costs improved the branch's profitability.
examples.zh: 成本降低改善了分公司的獲利能力。

entries.en: a request for information

examples.en: We received an inquiry about group bookings.
examples.zh: 我們收到一則團體訂位的詢問。

entries.en: documents or experience proving suitability

examples.en: Please submit your professional credentials.
examples.zh: 請提交你的專業資格證明。

entries.en: a person who starts a business with others

examples.en: The cofounder now leads product development.
examples.zh: 共同創辦人目前領導產品開發。

entries.en: a set of symbols or rules

examples.en: Enter the discount code at checkout.
examples.zh: 結帳時請輸入折扣碼。

entries.en: general agreement among a group

examples.en: The committee reached a consensus.
examples.zh: 委員會達成了共識。

entries.en: a room used for directors' meetings

examples.en: The boardroom is on the top floor.
examples.zh: 董事會會議室位於頂樓。

entries.en: a person or group affected by a project

examples.en: We consulted stakeholders before making changes.
examples.zh: 我們在變更前諮詢了利害關係人。

entries.en: money used to start or operate a business

examples.en: The company raised additional capital.
examples.zh: 公司籌集了額外資金。

entries.en: a new plan or willingness to act independently

examples.en: The initiative aims to reduce packaging waste.
examples.zh: 這項新措施旨在減少包裝廢棄物。

entries.en: an official written record of a meeting

examples.en: Please circulate the meeting minutes.
examples.zh: 請傳閱會議紀錄。

entries.en: the introduction of a new product or system

examples.en: The rollout will begin with two branches.
examples.zh: 這項系統將先在兩家分公司推出。

entries.en: a collection of work or investments

examples.en: Please bring your design portfolio.
examples.zh: 請攜帶你的設計作品集。

entries.en: a fixed amount to achieve or allow

examples.en: Each region has a monthly sales quota.
examples.zh: 每個區域都有每月銷售配額。

entries.en: a good reason supporting a decision

examples.en: The request needs a clear justification.
examples.zh: 這項申請需要明確的理由。

entries.en: a system ranking people or things

examples.en: The chart explains the management hierarchy.
examples.zh: 這張圖說明了管理階層。

entries.en: honesty or the state of being complete

examples.en: The auditor praised the team's integrity.
examples.zh: 稽核人員稱讚團隊的誠信。

entries.en: an incorrect belief

examples.en: The guide corrects common misconceptions.
examples.zh: 這份指南釐清了常見誤解。

entries.en: a network of interacting organizations or organisms

examples.en: The program strengthens the local startup ecosystem.
examples.zh: 這項計畫強化了當地新創生態系。

entries.en: an official connection with an organization

examples.en: Please state your company affiliation.
examples.zh: 請註明你所屬的公司。

entries.en: an amount beyond what is needed

examples.en: The surplus will fund next year's training.
examples.zh: 這筆盈餘將支應明年的訓練。

entries.en: an idea of a desired future

examples.en: The founder shared her vision for growth.
examples.zh: 創辦人分享了她的成長願景。

entries.en: the quality of being believable

examples.en: Accurate reporting strengthens our credibility.
examples.zh: 準確報導能提升我們的可信度。

entries.en: something limiting what can be done

examples.en: Time constraints affected the testing schedule.
examples.zh: 時間限制影響了測試時程。

entries.en: planning the movement of goods or resources

examples.en: The logistics team arranged equipment delivery.
examples.zh: 物流團隊安排了設備配送。

entries.en: the examination of data to find useful patterns

examples.en: We use analytics to understand buying habits.
examples.zh: 我們運用資料分析了解購買習慣。

entries.en: freedom to decide or care in handling information

examples.en: Refunds are issued at the manager's discretion.
examples.zh: 是否退款由經理自行裁量。
